info.name: FYRIRHYGGJA API
info.description: Complete REST API collection for FYRIRHYGGJA. Set the `base_url` and `token` collection variables (token auto-fills after Register/Verify OTP).

request.description: Starts an electronic ID (Auðkenni) sign-in, same as eid/start; no token is issued here. Send phone_code + phone_number (e-ID on SIM) or kennitala (Auðkenni app). Then call eid/poll. Dev test phone: 9999999.

Sends an Auðkenni prompt to the phone. Body: phone_number (7 digits) or kennitala, optional context Sim|App (defaults to Sim with a phone, App with only a kennitala). Show verification_code to the user.

202 {pending: true} until the person approves. Then 200 with a token for an existing user, or registered: false + person + registration_token (valid 30 minutes) for a new one. 401 when cancelled or expired.
Requires registration_token from eid/poll. kennitala and the verified phone are taken from the token; phone_code + phone_number are only needed when the token has no phone.
